title: InvenTrust Properties to Present at BofA Securities 2025 Global Real Estate Conference
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust,” “IVT” or the “Company”) today announced that DJ Busch, President and Chief Executive Officer; Mike Phillips, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer; and Christy David, Chief Operating Officer, General Counsel and Secretary, will present at the BofA Securities 2025 Global Real Estate Conference on Wednesday, September 10, 2025, at 11:05 a.m. Eastern Time. Event: InvenTrust Roundtable Presentation at BofA Securities 2025 Global Real Estate Conference Date: Wednesday, September 10, 2025 Time: 11:05 a.m. Eastern Time Live Webcast: https://bofa.veracast.com/webcasts/bofa/realestate2025/QM606m.cfm A replay of the webcast will be posted within 24 hours after the conclusion of the live event to the Company’s Investor Relations portion of the website at https://www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ .
